text_block_list.text:
On this day, I was doing early-morning training
with Narita Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: How was... my time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh!? That can't be...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I got enough sleep, and I ate breakfast...
Hmm, there's no obvious cause...
—Hey, you forgot to drink this.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I get it! The milk!
That's why I wasn't feeling well!
Thank you so much, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Puhaah!! Mornings just aren't the same without this!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It's an old habit of mine.
I just can't get into the groove without drinking it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Man, I totally knew she'd mess it up.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
She was super hyped up 'cause her times have been improving lately.
And then this morning too—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Breakfast is ready! Now just to pour the milk and—aaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I've got a great idea!
Since today's training is so early in the morning when nobody's around anyway!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I should borrow some obstacles and set them up!
That way, I can work muscles I don't usually use and get even faster!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Now that that's settled!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Is she... gonna be okay?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"When I focus on one thing,
I tend to neglect everything else and mess up sometimes~."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: T-That's... I do regret it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Wasn't it the same during the test? You got so caught up memorizing formulas that you forgot your pencil case, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Running while chanting math formulas under your breath—
you were pretty fast! It was tough catching up to you~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
T-That was... because of an important exam!
I was just completely absorbed in formulas, and...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Then how about that time? When you insisted on
hanging a teru teru bozu, out in the rain—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan!! I'm really sorry about that!
So please... no more, spare me...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway!
Thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Well, don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I kinda owe it to you
that I don't have to take remedial classes, y'know~
choice_data_list: You two have a great relationship.
You two have a nice relationship.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! I think so too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Out of the countless people here at Tracen Academy, it's nothing short of a miraculous twist of fate that we ended up as roommates!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Just wishing for each other to stay healthy... naturally led to us helping one another."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say our teamwork
is the best in all of Tracen Academy!
Right, Pokke-chan?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: No... isn't that taking it a bit too far?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? No waay...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ah, damn it! I went too far!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
! So that means...!
We really are the best roommates in the whole academy!

It seems Narita Top Road is doing
well in her dorm room too.
choice_data_list: Keep joining forces and do your best!
Keep joining forces and doing your best!
Looks like we could both gain something by working together!
Looks like we could both gain something by working together, huh!

text_block_list.text:
It seems Narita Top Road is doing
well in her dorm room too.
choice_data_list: Keep joining forces and do your best!
Keep joining forces and doing your best!
Looks like we could both gain something by working together!
Looks like we could both gain something by working together, huh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! From here on out, the two of us
will overcome academy life together!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't drag me into this out of nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Why not?!
We're going to be roommates from now on anyway! Right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! Like talking about each other's good points, perhaps? For Pokke-chan, maybe your wonderful smile?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Aah?! You... What's gotten into you all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A smile! When you smile, Pokke-chan,
it brightens up everyone around you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I think that's your greatest charm!
I just love your smile, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Daaahhh!!
I said stop it!!
